brief: Create a 15-second English ad for Luma Soap, a handmade lavender soap bar in a paper wrap. Audience: adults choosing small gifts. Objective: collection visits. Show the supplied original test product illustration. Do not research; these are all the offer facts.

Create a 15-second English concept for Still Room, a local massage service. Objective: appointment enquiries. The only known service fact is that it offers massage; ask one useful question if needed. Do not invent location, price, treatments, qualifications or medical outcomes.

Create a 15-second English lead ad for First Phrase, an online beginner Spanish course. It offers short recorded lessons and speaking exercises. Audience: adults hesitant to start speaking. Objective: signups for the course information list. Do not research. Do not invent fluency deadlines, accreditation, price or guarantees.
